verify_r67_review.py.description: Standard-library deterministic audit of the frozen R67 publication artifact and principal comparisons

blocking_findings: The successful object is a method-neutral certified search procedure; the neural network supplies an optional query proposal but not validity, termination, or the original-optimum guarantee.

The ReLU selector saves about two percent of Bellman queries in the small task but is about 110 percent slower in complete cold-start time, and it is worse on both queries and time in the harder task.

Prospective reuse yields only four complete-process wins out of twenty-four; all are quadratic services in the small task, no ReLU process wins, and the only persistent prefix crossing occurs at the final observed block.
All twelve direct continuous-law policy-cost intervals contain zero and are orders of magnitude wider than the observed raw mean differences.
The certified fixed-feature readout theorem is not executed as a central benchmark arm with prospective predictor-independent validation and a demonstrated work advantage.
The two-control, two-innovation extension exposes severe horizon growth: about 8.1 million Bellman action queries and 530--841 seconds at four dates.
The publication replay does not independently re-integrate the largest vector trees or every reuse and inference endpoint query.
All services returning establishes verifier reliability, not predictor reliability; forty-eight fitting warnings are retained and concentrated in ReLU fits.
The economic purchase conclusion remains unresolved because all gain intervals cross zero and prices and adoption fees are user-supplied rather than estimated.
The active title and retained platform remain broader than the established convex expected-cost theorem--algorithm--evidence chain.

erratum.correction: Allocate independent lower and upper cumulative-cost buffers before in-place updates

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun fitting, Bellman services, policy simulation, LaTeX, or clocks; new executions would create new observations.
The audit verifies the frozen artifact, recomputes reported comparisons, and checks the principal theorem chain, but it is not an independent formal proof of every inherited result.
Single-host process times are descriptive observations and support no hardware-general timing inference.
The publication replay re-queries the ninety distinct scalar comparison services but does not independently re-integrate the largest vector trees or every reuse and inference endpoint query.
Direct policy-cost intervals are conditional on the declared independent-bin model and frozen callable policies.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
positive_findings: R67 is a complete, canonical, clean-rebuildable submission with exceptional provenance and failure preservation.
The pre-query closure theorem replaces an unknown minimizer distance by a computable certificate based on already purchased endpoints.
Prediction cannot forge a certificate; failed screens leave the conventional safeguarded fallback intact.
The work loss and certified fixed-feature readout give an auditable optimization and additional-work account.
The comparison includes strong conventional and non-neural predictor controls under a common gate.
Prospective reuse, stale-model rejection, and actual continuous-law policy-cost inference are executed rather than assumed.
The two-control theorem is executed and its adverse horizon scaling is disclosed.
A substantive path-enclosure error is preserved, reproduced by an exact counterexample, corrected, and fully rerun.
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not continue the cumulative manuscript through another ordinary revision round. A new, sharply focused paper on certificate-gated, prediction-guided Bellman search could merit evaluation, but R67 does not establish an Econometrica-level method-specific or economic advantage for Neural Bellman Operators.
